top_signals.title: U.S. famine monitor to halt reporting as funding shortfall hits staff, sources say
top_signals.summary: More than half the field workers at the Famine Early Warning Systems Network will lose their jobs by the end of the year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
